```yaml
name: Update Lint Config

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-lint-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up mise
        uses: jdx/mise-action@v3
        with:
          version: 2025.8.16
          experimental: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Download latest lint config
        run: |
          curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gruntwork-io/terragrunt/main/.golangci.yml --output .golangci.yml.tmp
          echo '# This file is generated using `make update-lint-config` to track the linting used in Terragrunt. Do not edit manually.' | cat - .golangci.yml.tmp > .golangci.yml
          rm .golangci.yml.tmp

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          if ! git diff --quiet .golangci.yml; then
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add .golangci.yml
          git commit -m "chore: update lint config from terragrunt" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:update-lint-config || echo "Push failed, branch might already exist"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update lint config from terragrunt"
          title: "chore: update lint config from terragrunt"
          body: "This PR updates the lint configuration from the upstream Terragrunt repository."
          branch: update-lint-config
          delete-branch: true
```
